projects.name: راوا
projects.direction: Persian RTL freight logistics website. Tangerine orange, midnight ink and warm off-white. Asymmetric SPLIT layout: left 62% is a very large flat schematic global route MAP drawn in fine cream lines with physical shipping-container photography clipped into angular geographic cutouts, right 38% contains oversized Persian headline «مسیر روشنِ بار شما» and a precise white shipment-tracking input panel. Tall orange vertical service rail on extreme right, thin flight-path animation traces and package silhouettes. Practical contemporary Swiss transport typography, sharp corners and numbered lane labels, no centered 3D orb. Top brand «راوا», CTA «رهگیری مرسوله». A bold map-led industrial composition.

projects.name: مهر

title.fa: مهر؛ انرژی خورشیدی و خدمات نصب

projects.direction: Persian RTL renewable energy website. Sunflower yellow, black and crisp ivory. FULL-BLEED real architectural photography of sunlit photovoltaic panels on a dramatic desert ridge, shot from a low drone angle, strong diagonal perspective. Huge black condensed Persian headline «انرژیِ فردا، از امروز» sits on an offset yellow rectangular billboard occupying upper-right; a compact white project-scope enquiry panel sits bottom-left within the same hero. Thin sun-arc line-work suggests subtle motion over the photographic horizon. Restrained technical top nav «مهر» and CTA «بررسی پروژه». Angular industrial typography, no dark neon and no three-card template.

projects.name: دنا
projects.direction: Persian RTL high-performance automotive showroom concept. Deep racing burgundy, charcoal and polished silver. A huge fictional unbranded silver sports coupe photographed in a real concrete studio/racetrack tunnel crosses diagonally from lower-left to center, with cinematic but realistic red light strips receding into depth. Giant outlined Persian typography «حرکت، با شخصیت» occupies the full upper third behind the vehicle. A narrow vertical model-selector rail on the right, a small sober specification strip on the left and a single solid burgundy CTA «دیدن مدل‌ها». Extreme widescreen editorial automotive composition, strong mechanical character, original car shape with no existing manufacturer emblem or trade dress.

projects.name: لوما
projects.direction: Persian RTL jewellery ecommerce art direction. Porcelain white, antique gold and dark chocolate. LUXURY MAGAZINE COVER composition, not dark: enormous macro photograph of an original sculptural gold ring with a softly imperfect pearl on crumpled cream silk, vertically cropped in a central irregular oval. Right column has refined oversized Persian headline «درخششِ شخصی تو» with elegant thin-stroke lettering and ample negative space; left edge has a tall vertical contact-sheet filmstrip of three close-up product angles as hero image navigation. Small top monogram «لوما», discreet cart/search, underline CTA «کشف مجموعه». Fine hairline separators and subtly layered shadows, warm window light and tactile materials, no futuristic chrome blobs.

projects.name: میزان

title.fa: میزان؛ هویت و سایت خدمات حقوقی

projects.direction: Persian RTL legal services identity concept. Midnight blue, parchment ivory and restrained oxidized copper. Sophisticated PRINT NEWSPAPER / EDITORIAL GRID layout with a large vertical warm black-and-white architectural photograph of courthouse-like stone columns at center-left, right aligned typographic statement «شفافیت، پیش از تصمیم» in large elegant Persian serif-inspired lettering, a disciplined vertical contents index on the far right, and a small consultation-topic selector card overlapping the photograph at lower-left. Top brand «میزان», solid modest CTA «طرح پرسش». Thin ruling lines, generous margins and tiny folio decoration. No scales-of-justice cliche, no human headshots, no verdict promises, fabricated awards or client counts.

projects.name: روشن
projects.direction: Persian RTL skills learning platform. Joyful cobalt blue, tomato coral, butter yellow and white. LARGE KINETIC TYPOGRAPHY «یاد بگیر، بساز، ادامه بده» in bold playful Persian occupies a staggered 3-line staircase on the right half. Left half is an original tactile paper-cut collage of a notebook, geometric coding tiles, a small illustrated pencil and one dimensional orange sphere, carefully art-directed and physical, not a generic 3D robot. One tilted cream course-preview card with progress dots overlaps the collage, a thin horizontal subject-selector bar anchors the bottom of this single hero. Top brand «روشن», CTA «پیدا کردن مسیر». Color blocking, offset outlines, flat expressive motion-graphic shapes, no uniform SaaS card grid, no fake learning outcomes.

projects.name: پرتو
projects.direction: Persian RTL industrial automation equipment website. Safety orange, technical graphite and cool white. Bright precise ENGINEERING CAD WORKSPACE art direction: a realistic original orange industrial robotic arm on an immaculate white plane dominates the left, surrounded by very fine orthographic drawing lines and restrained exploded-part callouts. Right is a strong typographic column «دقت، در هر حرکت» with a short service description and compact technical inquiry form; far-left narrow dark vertical catalogue spine, top disciplined nav «پرتو», CTA «بررسی نیاز فنی». Tiny restrained schematic diagram at lower-right as part of the hero. Clear 2D technical grid combined with physically plausible machine photography, not shiny sci-fi.

projects.name: نوا

title.fa: نوا؛ اجراهای زنده و رزرو رویداد

projects.direction: Persian RTL live-music ticket discovery website. Electric fuchsia, deep aubergine and fluorescent apricot. FULL-BLEED authentic photograph of an original anonymous concert stage and beams of warm haze; no recognizable performer. Huge heavily condensed Persian headline «صدای امشب را پیدا کن» crops boldly across the LEFT 60%, with an asymmetric vertical event DATE/TIME browsing strip on the right, one striking peach ticket-shaped hero card at bottom-center and a minimal bottom search rail for city and genre. Top brand «نوا», CTA «دیدن اجراها». Grunge-print texture meets precisely designed ticket UI; energetic typographic culture poster aesthetic, not a normal company landing page and no generic floating 3D objects.

projects.name: Tide
projects.direction: English LTR Web3 decentralized-exchange liquidity workspace named TIDE. Deep forest-black, acid lime and smoky mint. TERMINAL + TOPOGRAPHIC MAP layout: large topographic liquidity contour visualization across center-left formed from thin lime elevation lines, live-looking compact market-depth bars at left edge, and an unusually tall clean swap/review panel taking the right third. Upper-left headline 'LIQUIDITY, IN MOTION.' set in restrained monospaced caps. Thin full-width horizontal route explorer directly below headline, precise separators, tiny subdued rows. Top nav Trade / Pools / Routes, CTA 'Preview swap', an explicit small 'Demo' status. No cyan holographic torus, no shiny coin pile, no yield promise, no profit chart or existing token/company logos. A genuinely professional dense financial interface concept.

projects.name: Cinder
projects.direction: English LTR DAO governance platform CINDER. Warm off-white, brick-red and nearly black. CIVIC EDITORIAL / NEWSPAPER BOARD aesthetic: a huge cropped slab-serif headline 'BUILD THE NEXT DECISION.' aligned left, right half shows tactile stacked paper proposal sheets with one red wax-like abstract seal and black rectangular voting-status stamps, no company logos. Below headline within hero is a slim readable active-proposal strip and two deliberately different panel shapes: tall discussion preview and compact voting summary, not a generic grid. Strong vertical red rule at left, horizontal black hairlines, top nav Proposals / Delegates / Treasury, main button 'Explore proposals', small 'Design demo'. No futuristic neon, no coin objects, no real voting outcomes or treasury values.

projects.name: Kora
projects.direction: English LTR original Web3 digital collectibles platform KORA. Lavender, lilac, matte black and pale jade. AVANT-GARDE INTERACTIVE GALLERY layout: a large original sculptural ceramic creature/artifact with an abstract looped shell, softly translucent lilac material and beautiful physical studio light sits inside a huge cropped circular gallery aperture on the LEFT; bold stacked black headline 'COLLECT A DIFFERENT WORLD.' occupies right, small mint material/edition selector controls underneath. A slim vertical filmstrip of four truly distinct original art-object silhouettes at far right forms hero navigation, a tiny studio-caption note bottom-left. Top minimal KORA wordmark and 'Explore objects' CTA. Museum/art-direction typography, playful but premium, not cartoon apes, no known NFT trade dress, no speculative pricing, no invented creator endorsements.

projects.name: Aster

title.fa: Aster؛ پایش سرویس و داشبورد ابری

projects.direction: English LTR cloud observability SaaS ASTER. Very pale ice-blue/white, graphite and sharp electric indigo. LAYERED TECHNICAL BLUEPRINT layout: the entire canvas is bright and quiet, oversized ultra-light headline 'SEE THE SYSTEM. FIND THE SIGNAL.' at upper-left. On the right two overlapping translucent-but-realistic flat dashboard windows sit at a small perspective angle: a service dependency node graph and a focused incident timeline. A thin indigo signal line threads from the headline margin into the windows, with tiny precise square markers suggesting motion. One horizontal use-case rail at bottom within hero; clean ASTER brand and 'Explore the demo' CTA. Sophisticated understated enterprise UI, no giant blue billboard ribbon, no dark card-grid template, no fabricated uptime guarantee or performance claim.
